apple.name: Apple
apple.description: Crispy round fruit with sweet or tart flavor, commonly red, green, or yellow.
apple.nutrition: High in fiber and vitamin C
apple.fun_fact: There are over 7,500 varieties of apples worldwide!

banana.name: Banana
banana.description: Long curved tropical fruit with soft sweet flesh and a yellow peel when ripe.
banana.nutrition: Rich in potassium and vitamin B6
banana.fun_fact: Bananas are berries, but strawberries are not!

orange.name: Orange
orange.description: Round citrus fruit with a tough, shiny, orange rind and juicy, segmented flesh.
orange.fun_fact: The word "orange" came from the Sanskrit word for "orange tree".

grapes.name: Grapes
grapes.description: Small, round or oval-shaped berries that grow in clusters on vines.
grapes.nutrition: Good source of vitamin K and antioxidants
grapes.fun_fact: There are more than 8,000 varieties of grapes in the world.

strawberry.name: Strawberry
strawberry.description: Red, juicy, heart-shaped fruit, covered in tiny seeds.
strawberry.nutrition: High in vitamin C and manganese
strawberry.fun_fact: Strawberries are the only fruit with seeds on the outside.
